title: Grammar Transfer — Precision Check
description: Use fresh sentences to retest agreement and commonly confused words.
subject: rla
author: Chee Skool

questions.prompt: The list of required materials {{blank}} posted beside the laboratory door.

options.whyWrong: The nearby plural noun 'materials' is inside a prepositional phrase. The true subject is the singular noun 'list.'
This changes the sentence to past tense and still distracts from the singular subject.
This plural verb phrase does not agree with the singular subject 'list.'

explanation.whyCorrect: The subject is 'list,' which is singular. 'Of required materials' does not change the subject, so 'is' is correct.
explanation.quickTip: Ignore nouns inside prepositional phrases when you match the subject with the verb.

questions.prompt: The technicians placed {{blank}} tools on the inspection table before beginning the test.

options.whyWrong: 'There' refers to a place. It does not show ownership of the tools.
'They're' means 'they are,' which cannot come before the noun 'tools' here.
'Theirs' stands alone. The sentence needs a possessive word directly before 'tools.'

explanation.whyCorrect: 'Their' is the possessive word needed directly before the noun 'tools.'
explanation.quickTip: Use 'their' before a noun to show ownership; 'there' is a place and 'they're' means 'they are.'

curriculum.learningObjective: Apply subject–verb agreement and commonly confused word rules in new sentences.
